reason: The order commands "do order that the said Code of Fair Competition be and it is hereby approved" for the Code of Fair Competition for the Electrical Manufacturing Industry under title I of the National Industrial Recovery Act; the approval has legal effect only through section 3 of that title (SUPPLEMENT:NIRA3). Section 2 of S.J. Res. 113, approved June 14, 1935, provides "All the provisions of Title I of such Act delegating power to the President to approve or prescribe codes of fair competition and providing for the enforcement of such codes are hereby repealed", so the prospective operative effect of this approval ended on June 14, 1935, the date of approval, because the resolution states no later effective date. No held record shows this code cancelled or suspended earlier, and the order states no own-terms end. June 16, 1935 is not an end, since section 1 of the resolution replaced that expiry with April 1, 1936. The Schechter decision of May 27, 1935 is recorded only as a validity characterization, not an end date.
